num_agents: <int> Number of agents available to perform jobs.
num_jobs: <int> Number of jobs that must be assigned to agents.
profits: <list[list[int]], shape [num_agents][num_jobs]> Profit earned when a given agent performs a given job.
weights: <list[list[int]], shape [num_agents][num_jobs]> Amount of resource capacity consumed when a given agent performs a given job.
capacities: <list[int], length num_agents> Maximum total weight of jobs that each agent can handle.
